headline: ATEEZ top Billboard 200 for the 4th time
sub: 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6' debuts at No. 1 with 195,000 units

points.title: Why it matters
items: 10 top-10 albums in a row since 2022
Most top 10s of any group this decade
Sold 2.05M copies in week one on Hanteo

caption:
ATEEZ have landed their fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200!

Their new mini album 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6', led by title track 'UP', debuted at the top with 195,000 equivalent album units, 191,000 of them from album sales. It follows 'THE WORLD EP.FIN : WILL', 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.2' and 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5' — and marks their 10th straight top-10 album, the most of any group in the 2020s.

📌 Source: Billboard, via Korean media (Hankyung, Asia Today)
